alex_cust: Hey @jaz_support — sending follow-up. We got an invoice yesterday that shows ~9.2M tokens billed but our dashboard + local SDK counters show ~6.1M. Can we get help reconciling?

jaz_support: Thanks for reporting — sorry about the surprise. Can you share a single request example or a short repro? inbox me if sensitive.

alex_cust: pasted a sanitized curl below. This is representative:
```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions \\\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"model\":\"open-llama-70b\",\"prompt\":\"Summarize...\",\"max_tokens\":1024,\"stream\":true}'\n```
We stream results and sometimes reconnect on network blips. SDK estimate per call ~1.8k tokens; invoice suggests ~2.7k per call on average.

jaz_support: Do you have a short timeframe (start/end) for the spike and an example request id from meters? If reconnects are frequent that could cause doubling on the server side for last chunk.

alex_cust: Spike was 2026-08-02 03:20-04:10 UTC. I grabbed one request_id: req_20260802_9a7b.

ravi_eng: looping in @kelsey_metering — from runtime side we recently added a tiny server-side prefix that we inject when we route to the toolchain for function-calls/structured outputs. Usually small but if reconnect + partial retry happens it can appear multiple times.

kelsey_metering: Checking meters for req_20260802_9a7b... I see three server-side events for that request: initial stream start, reconnect:resume, finalization. The raw meter shows tokens: 1802, 2700, 1802 (approx). The invoice records the sum of emitted tokens across events (so 6304) while the SDK estimator dedupes based on client session and only counts 1802.

alex_cust: Ok that explains duping. How does the server-side prefix play into this?

kelsey_metering: The prefix is a short system message injected before the model input when we attach the tool metadata (for telemetry + safety). Example: \"system:tool-metadata:{...}\" — usually ~20-40 tokens. On reconnect/resume we replay the tail of the session including that prefix unless the client supplies a resume token that the runtime recognizes. If the client reconnects without the resume handshake, the runtime treats it as a new logical attempt and bills the full combined tokens.

jaz_support: Quick mitigation: if you can add resume tokens in the streaming client (see snippet), the runtime will dedupe server-side replays. Also we can retroactively look at invoice windows if it's clearly a runtime-side duping bug.
ravi_eng: snippet for SDK resume logic: 
```js
const s = startStream({session_id: sid});
if (s.resume_token) { s.resume(resume_token); }
```
If resume_token not sent we create a new logical attempt id.

alex_cust: We use a custom websocket client that treats network drop as a new connection (no resume). We can change that but this would be a breaking deploy for our infra. Any short-term options?

kelsey_metering: Short-term options: 1) We can enable a server-side de-dup window for your org for the invoice period (manual cleanup) if you want us to audit the events and zero out obvious duplicates. 2) We can switch you to non-prefixed routing for that model (removes the extra system token) but that impacts tooling metadata/traceability.

jaz_support: We can open an escalation with billing. If you confirm you want us to audit the 2026-08-02 window, I will ask billing to review and propose a credit for duplicates identified.

alex_cust: Please do the audit. Also can you file a runtime ticket so we get a permanent fix for resume handshake enforcement? This is pretty high impact for us.

billing-bot: [AUTO] Billing case created: #BILL-12231 — Investigator assigned. ETA 48hr. :white_check_mark:

ravi_eng: filed infra ticket INF-8803 to enforce resume_token required semantics on reconnects for streaming endpoints. I'll add a runtime toggle to disable server-side prefixing for sensitive tenants while we roll a fix.
kelsey_metering: I'll export the meter lines (PMing you the CSV) and flag candidate duplicates. Jaz, please include that with the billing case.
jaz_support: Will do. Alex — we'll follow up in #BILL-12231 and ping here with outcome. Thanks for the clear repro and the request_id, that sped up triage. :party_parrot:
